note: P4351 (Pro 29:18) — where there is no vision the people cast off restraint; blessed is the law-keeper.

dims.v: moral anarchy — a people running wild for lack of revelation

the casting-off of restraint by a people who have no prophetic vision — the moral anarchy that breaks out where God's word is not heard, each doing as he pleases, the opposite of the blessed law-keeper
the law-keeping it is set against (266812)
set against the blessed one who keeps the law

para (let loose / cast off restraint) — 'where there is no prophetic VISION the people cast off restraint'; without God's revealed word a people run wild, ungoverned. Emergent: moral anarchy as the fruit of a lost revelation (cf Ex 32:25; 1 Sam 3:1).
blessed obedience — the one who keeps the law amid a lawless people
the keeping of the law that is pronounced blessed — the faithful obedience that holds fast to God's word where others cast off restraint, the anchor amid moral anarchy
the unrestraint it is set against (266809)
set against the people who cast off restraint
shamar (keep/guard) — 'but blessed is he who keeps the LAW'; where a people run wild, the one who keeps God's law is blessed and steady. Obedience is an anchor in an age without vision.
